How can I control it without chemicals?
reply_en: Without synthetic chemicals: 1) Dig 30 cm deep trenches around the field perimeter and dust with lime/ash. 2) Conduct pesticide spraying strictly in late afternoon or dusk (after 4:30 PM). 3) Spray botanical Neem oil (1500 ppm) @ 3-5 ml/L.
